# API-sport

> > API-sport provides comprehensive sports data APIs with REST and WebSocket support for real-time statistics, betting platforms, and analytics across football, basketball, hockey, and other sports.

API-sport delivers live scores, player metrics (xG, xA), head-to-head analysis, and event data through flexible API integration. The platform supports developers, betting services, and analysts with real-time data feeds, statistical analysis tools, and comparison guides against competing APIs like FONBET.

## Key Topics

- API-sport
- REST API
- WebSocket
- Sports events API
- Real-time statistics
- xG (expected goals)
- xA (expected assists)
- Sports data integration
- Betting platforms
- Player ratings
- H2H analysis
- Football API
- NBA API
- Hockey API
- AI prediction services
